name: Splash
description: Swift highlighter with HTML, attributed-string, and image output; used in Swift publishing tools

host-language.comment: Pure Swift package (Swift Package Manager); requires a Swift 5.2+ toolchain per README.

form-factor.comment: Package.swift exports the Splash library plus four executables: SplashHTMLGen, SplashMarkdown, SplashImageGen (macOS only), SplashTokenizer (debug tool).

package.comment: Distributed via Swift Package Manager from the Git repository; Swift Package Index is the registry-style listing.

documentation.comment: No dedicated docs site; README plus doc comments in the public source files.

latest-version.comment: Checked 2026-11-19. master has a few later untagged commits (June 2022, e.g. 'any' keyword support).

engine-model.comment: Delimiter-based tokenizer plus an ordered list of hand-written Swift SyntaxRule structs (13 rules in SwiftGrammar) that inspect previous/next/same-line tokens; first matching rule assigns the token type.

regex-engine.comment: No regex at all: rules use plain string/CharacterSet operations (hasPrefix, hasSuffix, comparisons). n/a used because no regex engine runs the grammar.

embedded-languages.comment: Only a Swift grammar ships; no HTML/JS/CSS or injection mechanism.

language-auto-detection.comment: Single-language tool; the grammar is chosen at init (defaults to SwiftGrammar). MarkdownDecorator highlights every fenced block with that grammar.

filename-extension-mapping.comment: No language lookup of any kind; grammar is passed explicitly.

resumable-line-state.comment: Tokenizer is internal and keeps line state privately; highlight(_:) always processes a whole string.

semantic-distinctions.comment: Has call/type/property/dotAccess token types, but these come from token-neighbourhood heuristics (e.g. capitalised identifier = type, identifier followed by '(' = call), not a syntax tree; no definition vs call or parameter vs local distinction.

bundled-languages.comment: Swift only (SwiftGrammar.swift is the sole grammar), v0.16.0 / master checked 2026-11-19. An unmerged PR (#134) adds a basic JS grammar.

grammar-format.comment: Grammars are Swift types conforming to the Grammar protocol (delimiters + [SyntaxRule]).

runtime-grammar-loading.comment: Public Grammar/SyntaxRule protocols; a user-defined grammar can be passed to SyntaxHighlighter's initializer without forking. Grammars are compiled Swift code, not data files.

lazy-grammar-loading.comment: Not applicable: only one built-in grammar, compiled into the library.

grammar-accuracy.comment: Heuristic hand-written Swift rules, tracked through Swift 5.5 concurrency (0.16.0) and 'any' (untagged master, 2022). No updates since for Swift 5.9 macros, Swift 6 etc.; multi-line interpolation fix PR (#131) unmerged. Solid for common constructs, gaps on newer syntax.

bundled-themes.comment: v0.16.0: sundellsColors, midnight, wwdc17, wwdc18, sunset, presentation — Theme structs for NSAttributedString/image output (not available on Linux). HTML output has one example stylesheet (Examples/sundellsColors.css).

theme-format.comment: Swift Theme struct (font, colours per TokenType) for attributed-string/image output; user CSS for HTML class output.

token-classification.comment: TokenType enum: keyword, string, type, call, number, comment, property, dotAccess, preprocessing, plus custom(String) for user grammars.

css-class-output.comment: HTMLOutputFormat wraps tokens in <span class="<prefix><type>">; optional classPrefix. Class-only, no inline styles.

multi-theme-output.comment: Class-based HTML could be restyled, but only one example stylesheet ships and there is no documented light/dark mechanism.

public-token-api.comment: Via the public OutputFormat/OutputBuilder protocols: a custom builder receives addToken(_:ofType:), addPlainText, addWhitespace callbacks and can return any type (e.g. an array of tokens). The Tokenizer itself is internal.

ir-kinds.comment: (text, TokenType) stream delivered to an OutputBuilder.

serializable-ir.comment: No documented serialization (TokenType is not Codable); SplashTokenizer CLI prints a debug text listing only.

theme-resolved-tokens.comment: Token stream carries only TokenType. Theme colours are applied only when rendering the final NSAttributedString (Apple platforms only), which native UIs can display directly.

source-offsets-in-ir.comment: Builder callbacks receive token strings and types only, no positions.

custom-formatter-api.comment: README documents implementing the OutputFormat protocol for custom outputs.

output-formats.comment: HTML with classes (HTMLOutputFormat); NSAttributedString (AttributedStringOutputFormat, non-Linux; tagged native-rich-text); image via SplashImageGen CLI (macOS only); Markdown with fenced blocks replaced by highlighted <pre> HTML (MarkdownDecorator / SplashMarkdown). Unmerged PR for SwiftUI Text output.

streaming-output.comment: highlight(_:) takes a complete String and returns the built output; no line-by-line API.

native-dependencies.comment: Pure Swift on Foundation, zero package dependencies. SplashImageGen uses AppKit/CoreGraphics (macOS only).

runs-in-browser.comment: No official browser distribution; Swift Package Index's build matrix reports Wasm compatibility, so it could in principle be used via SwiftWasm.

wasm-build.comment: Not documented by the project; Swift Package Index automated builds list Wasm as compatible (third-party check, not official support).

synchronous-api.comment: highlight(_:) is a plain synchronous function; no async initialisation.

bindings-ports.comment: Integrations exist (SplashPublishPlugin for Publish, a Jekyll tag) but no other-language bindings.

core-package-size.comment: Not comparable: Swift source package with no registry artifact size.

throughput-tier.comment: No independent or reproducible comparative benchmark found; README's 'fast' claim is unquantified.

initialization-cost.comment: Unmeasured; likely trivial (grammar is compiled-in Swift structs) but no measurement found.

monthly-downloads.comment: Swift Package Manager has no download statistics; Swift Package Index shows none.

maintenance-status.comment: Last commit on master 2022-06-08, last release 2021-06; 9 open PRs (latest May 2026, incl. Swift 6 and Linux crash fixes) unmerged. Not archived. Checked 2026-11-19.

documentation-quality.comment: Clear README with usage and CLI examples plus doc comments in public source, but no API reference or docs site.

notable-users.value: Swift by Sundell (swiftbysundell.com), Publish static site generator (via SplashPublishPlugin)

bus-factor.comment: John Sundell authored 144 of ~182 commits; next contributor has 9.
